name: central_room_pull
description: Walk from Corridor A (its levy already dealt with, as after levy_1v1_sensible) into Level 1's central room and bear right toward the Corridor B mouth, then stand, recording who engages. It's the baseline for detection through walls (design bible §3: detection needs line of sight; §4: an encounter never pulls enemies from another room): today the Corridor B archer detects the player through the room's south wall.
